crossRefs.note: Behold, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.
But Balaam answered Balak, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘All that Yahweh speaks, that I must do?’ ”
Balaam said to Balak, “Behold, I have come to you. Have I now any power at all to speak anything? The word that God…
‘If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond Yahweh’s word, to do either good or bad…
When his speech is charming, don’t believe him, for there are seven abominations in his heart.
For those who are such don’t serve our Lord, Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering…
They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any…

translations.web: He answered and said, “Must I not take heed to speak that which Yahweh puts in my mouth?”
translations.bsb: But Balaam replied, “Should I not speak exactly what the LORD puts in my mouth?”
translations.kjv: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD hath put in my mouth?
translations.asv: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which Jehovah putteth in my mouth?
